# Activities interface The **My Activities** page is the core interface for managing, viewing, and completing activities. It is accessed by clicking **ACTIVITIES** on the [top navigation bar](/the-user-interface/the-navigation-bar). ## The ‘My Activities’ list The Activities interface contains a list of all activities you are involved in. The list includes activities you * created, * were assigned to (tasks), * updated (for example by contributing to a revision in the pending change), * have been invited to approve, * or left a comment in. The list looks the same as the Activities tab list in the [Model Overview](/the-user-interface/models-ui/model-overview), except there are pre-defined categories to organize your activities in the banner at the top. You can click a category to view only the activities that belong to that category.
Approval requestedYour approval has been requested on these activities
AssignedActivities are assigned to you to complete
CommentedActivities you have left comments on
CreatedActivities created by you
In my modelsActivities for Models that you own personally or via a Group
Shared with meActivities shared with Groups you are a member of
ContributedActivities you have performed an action in
{% hint style="success" %} You cannot edit tags in the **My Activities** page. To edit the tags for an Activity, just click the Activity to open the detail page and edit the tags there. {% endhint %} See [Filtering and sorting the list of Activities](/the-user-interface/models-ui/model-overview#filtering-and-sorting-the-list-of-activities) to find out how to filter and sort the list of Activities.
